name: Cimarosa
description: Cimarosa was the homeworld of the Human Von Longo and his two sons, Kale Longo and Trig Longo. They lived on the world until sometime in 1 BBY, when they were arrested by the Galactic Empire, and placed on the prison barge Purge.
lead_paragraphs: Cimarosa was the homeworld of the Human Von Longo and his two sons, Kale Longo and Trig Longo. They lived on the world until sometime in 1 BBY, when they were arrested by the Galactic Empire, and placed on the prison barge Purge.
